channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about LeBron James | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about LeBron James from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James, Pablo Torre
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony on Pablo Torre:

“You got to take the stand and tell us which owners. Say the owner of the XYZ teams are asking about LeBron’s transportation. F** all that journalism sh**. Like I respect the journalism, but if we're going to keep it a buck, keep it a buck. Tell us who the owners are. Because if we were saying, if a player was saying something about the owners, that owner would find out who the f*** was saying that sh**, and we would be in a situation where we could be f***ed up… It's investigating too much, but I've said this previously that you got what you got, and I don't want you to stop being a journalist, because you do great journalism and I respect you as a journalist.”

Carmelo Anthony on LeBron James, Pablo Torre, Oct 15, 2026. Source: Youtube.

item.title: Evan Turner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Jalen Williams
item.description:
Turner continued to say of James.

“You look at the starting five. I don’t see him slowing down. Who’s better? I mean, who’s better? It’s almost like the Stefon Diggs thing. If I’m not the better one, who’s a better number two than me that’s just elite? I think Jalen Williams from OKC is one of the best top 15 players in the world, and I would throw ‘Bron up against him any night. Jalen Williams is elite. LeBron has got five or 10 more years the same way with Kevin Durant. They’re like, ‘Where am I going?’ There’s nothing else to do. This shit is easy.”

Evan Turner on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Jalen Williams, Oct 15, 2026. Source: rotogrinders.com.

item.title: Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Olden Polynice on how he would react if he was Joel Embiid and LeBron James walks into the locker room and starts setting standards:

“I’ll be like, you ain’t my daddy. You ain’t my daddy you my teammate, you know. You have to respect. Again, the man doesn’t walk on water. I will give you the respect, but that’s about it. You’re still not going to come in and just like dictate stuff. You know, first of all look, the man plays for the 76ers and he’s jumping on helicopters every day going to New York. It’s like how are you spending time with your teammates getting to know them outside of practice, which is something you should be trying to do.”

Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Oct 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Moritz Wagner on LeBron James
item.description:
“And LeBron was always there earlier. It’s crazy because he ain't got nothing to prove, you know? That's just how he breathes. That's how he lives, and that's what he does. So that definitely made an impact because if he can have that habit, why can't I? And, of course, I remember that.”

Moritz Wagner on LeBron James, Oct 8, 2026. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Moritz Wagner on LeBron James
item.description:
He learned early on that James is the standard for what it takes to succeed in the league.

“I think one thing that I've learned through LeBron is I was in rehab early on in my rookie year and I was in a weight room early every day to try to make practice on time, all of the stuff that you're trying to do when you're young,”

Moritz Wagner on LeBron James, Oct 8, 2026. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Mike Gansey on LeBron James
item.description:
Gansey on LeBron before today's BxW scrimmage:

“With LeBron, I just think there's no superlatives or words you can say what he does He set the tone from day one, really, when he got here, and he's the first one in the building, last one to leave. I mean, the guy is the biggest professional I've ever seen. Like just his routine, his habits, and I think some of our guys are seeing that, obviously. It's like, well, if LeBron's the first one in here today, you know, what am I doing? I'm a young guy coming in at 10 o'clock, where he's in here at 7:30. So I think it's rubbing off on a lot of the guys, and they see it, and hopefully, it just continues that way.”

Mike Gansey on LeBron James, Oct 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Glen Davis on LeBron James
item.description:
Glen Big Baby Davis on LeBron James:

“I hated guarding him. He was so good. He is really my GOAT.”

Glen Davis on LeBron James, Oct 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nick Nurse on LeBron James
item.description:
Nick Nurse on LeBron's daily routine at today's practice:

“I think that we saw a little bit of it in the summer. He’s a very early guy, so he's in here very early, and he's got his set, straight to the weight room when he gets in, and then he's into his skill work and all that kind of stuff. So, listen, I think he's obviously in great condition. Played a long time. He knows what he's doing with that stuff. And I mean, to me it's always great to see. I always again, I'm an early person too. Fired up to get up and start my day and get working, and I like that. I think that'll transcend to some players.”

Nick Nurse on LeBron James, Oct 2, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dean Wade on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Dean Wade on the high basketball IQ of new 76ers teammates:

“It is completely different. You know their tendencies playing against them, but when you are on the same team, you can pick their brain. My biggest thing is the way they think the game is the most impressive thing. Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, LeBron James, Jaylen Brown, everyone, the way they think the game is at such a high level. As an NBA player, you think you know the game well, and then you get on a team like this and it is night and day. You see the way they think about plays, think about defenses, the way they think about rotations. It is similar to some things I thought, but they go a little more in-depth and it is super impressive.”

Dean Wade on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nick Nurse on LeBron James, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Ausin Krell:Nick Nurse:

“[Embiid] and LeBron have both been a part of everything we've done. I will say they're both pretty smart about when we're scrimmaging and run 7 or 8 plays, they're getting themselves in and out. I think they're not overdoing it. But, yes, they want to get in shape, get the chemistry, feel.”

Nick Nurse on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Oct 1, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Nick Nurse on LeBron James
item.description:
Nick Nurse on LeBron James’ role in the Sixers offense:

“I consider him a great offense creator … and a table setter and all that kind of stuff.… If it isn't bringing it up and starting [the possession], it's probably going to be first pass anyway to [him on] the wing”

Nick Nurse on LeBron James, Oct 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dean Wade on LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Dean Wade on what has stood out about his new teammates:

“My biggest thing is the way they think the game is the most impressive thing. Tyrese, Joel, LeBron, JB, everyone. The way they think the game is such high level. As an NBA player, you think you know the game well and then you get on a team like this....it's night and day being on this side with them instead of against them.”

Dean Wade on LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey, Sep 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Austin Reaves on LeBron James
item.description:
“One of the biggest things I learned from LeBron was what he did every single day to give [himself] the opportunity to still play this game at the highest level,”

Austin Reaves on LeBron James, Sep 29, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Anfernee Simons on LeBron James
item.description:
Adam Aaronson:Anfernee Simons on playing alongside LeBron:

“It's crazy to see you've been teammates with somebody like LeBron James. I'm going to take full advantage.”

Anfernee Simons on LeBron James, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Labaron Philon on LeBron James
item.description:
Adam Aaronson:Labaron Philon on carving out a role on this team after the summer changes:

“LeBron joining, JB joining, it's definitely been great... Just trying to do things that get you on the floor, and it starts on the defensive end, really.”

Labaron Philon on LeBron James, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Draymond Green on LeBron James
item.description:
Draymond Green on LeBron James's Polymarket deal:

“It's great ...I hope to one day have a partnership. I definitely have an interest in the different markets and the things that you can predict,”

Draymond Green on LeBron James, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on LeBron James
item.description:
Maxey denies those claims, but did say he felt the 76ers had a legitimate chance to add LeBron James despite many ruling them out.

“I'm not going to say I knew and just didn't tell anyone, but I had multiple conversations with LeBron,”

Tyrese Maxey on LeBron James, Sep 22, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Draymond Green on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“You remember the day and age where Michael Jordan was celebrated, not ridiculed like LeBron James. The coverage of basketball as a whole was completely different. I grew up in that era, and now, being one of the players, and seeing that that's not a thing at all, nowadays, we want to talk about, I can't remember a single time where someone said, 'Man, Scottie Pippen need to win this game or his legacy is tarnished.'”

Draymond Green on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Sep 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kwame Brown on LeBron James
item.description:
Kwame Brown:

“I say that because they put him in that category. I don't see LeBron in that category. His longevity got him the numbers, but in big moments I see him as regular. LeBron can shy away from the moment at times, and I've never seen Kobe or MJ shy away from that moment. That's what they're built for.”

Kwame Brown on LeBron James, Sep 20, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on LeBron James
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“It's nothing I've ever experienced in basketball in my life. That Heat culture is absolutely real. Anyone who's been there, the practice facility, the locker room is downstairs, you got to go upstairs to get to the practice facility. Before you open the door to get to the practice facility, you have to have on knee pads and your jersey has to be tucked in every single time. I don't care who you is. Discipline off the rip. Before LeBron James got to the Heat, they didn't have a motherfucker with no headband. Think about it.”

Patrick Beverley on LeBron James, Sep 18, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on LeBron James
item.description:
Dwyane Wade on LeBron James signing with 76ers:

“How can I say this without saying it too much. I don't want to say too much... I don’t think we’ve seen the end of what this move is. I think it’s more to this move. And so, I’ll just leave it at that”

Dwyane Wade on LeBron James, Sep 17, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Derik Queen on LeBron James, James Harden
item.description:
Derik Queen:

“Really James Harden. When I wanted to learn how to dribble, he was on the Rockets doing his one-on-one stuff. Even Oklahoma City, I caught the later years of OKC. But when he was on the Rockets, he just used to do his one-on-one and I was just like, I want to do that. Him and LeBron are my favorite players. LeBron, I'm not athletic like him, but all three of us can pass. Those two were my favorite, so I just try to play like them, but at a different size and I'm not fast like them. I still fry you though.”

Derik Queen on LeBron James, James Harden, Sep 15, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell
item.description:
Richard Jefferson:

“There is no GOAT in basketball because there's multiple levels. Kareem Abdul-Jabbar I think had the greatest career, Bill Russell won the most championships, Michael Jordan is the icon, and I think Kobe Bryant and what he did mentally for the game and really for athletes all around the world. ButI would just say if you were to build a basketball player, you could not build a better basketball player than LeBron James. There's no skill set he doesn't have, there's no physical ability. So for me, if I was building a basketball player, mentally and physically, he would be the person that I would build.”

Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell, Sep 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on LeBron James, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“We all get a licensing check. LeBron James, Steph Curry, Kawhi Leonard, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Nikola Jokic, they all get the same jersey sales as the rookie. Excuse me, as a rookie, you don't get a license check because the license check is from a year before. But say a second-year guy who didn't play much on a team, and the license check was 500 grand, that's jersey sales. That's all of the licensing things, right? That same 500 grand that that second-year guy gets, Steph Curry gets. It's divvied up, it's even split. And so, you could make 300,000, you could make 500,000, but every player makes the same amount.”

Draymond Green on LeBron James, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Sep 11, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Delonte West on LeBron James
item.description:
Delonte West:

“We were playing Cleveland, out in Seattle, the first month of the season, and I was cooking them. I remember we were sitting at the foul line, and LeBron James, he was like, man, I followed you in college. You remember that time I came to Philly at the Palestra to watch you play? And I was like, yeah, I remember. He was like, man, you want to come play with Cleveland? I thought he was just doing a veteran trick. (...)I thought he was just trying to get me out of my game by getting familiarity. But he was serious. He asked me to come play with Cleveland.”

Delonte West on LeBron James, Sep 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Adem Bona on LeBron James
item.description:
Adem Bona on his initial reaction to learning that him and LeBron were teammates:

“I just started screaming at the top of my voice in the car. We just started jumping in the car, and the car started like moving, bouncing literally.”

Adem Bona on LeBron James, Aug 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on LeBron James
item.description:
Jason Kidd:

“I have talked about the Joker, but since you brought LeBron up,I would say LeBron's game is... my game is the closest to LeBron, even though his game is at a different altitude. He has the ability to make plays for his teammates. His IQ, understanding what is going to happen before it happens, is extremely high. Those are the two players when you talk about passing and just their basketball IQ.”

Jason Kidd on LeBron James, Aug 30, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Delonte West on LeBron James
item.description:
Speaking recently on Kick streamer N3on’s livestream, West shared how the James family still makes him feel belonged.

“A lot of those guys that I play with, LeBron, he's my ‘him’, and you know his family…called my mom all the time to make sure I'm okay,”

Delonte West on LeBron James, Aug 24, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Delonte West on LeBron James
item.description:
West said during the stream.

“Miss Gloria (Gloria Marie James, LeBron’s mother). She called my mom; she’s still the same. You know, (she used to say) ‘Tell my son. I seen him; you better get it together, don't make me come take on',”

Delonte West on LeBron James, Aug 24, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on LeBron James
item.description:
Rajon Rondo:

“Brilliant move. He’s arguably the young best point guard in the game. I think he averaged 30 points a game this year. LeBron James is the king on the chessboard. He has all the right pieces to make the right moves. We all know he is a great basketball mind, one of the greatest basketball minds to play the game. If you give him these type of pieces to play with, I am an early bet with them being the favorites to win in my book.”

Rajon Rondo on LeBron James, Aug 16, 2026. Source: YouTube.
